title: Most Visited Sector in  a Circular Track
summary: Given an integer n and an integer array rounds , consider a circular track divided into n sectors labeled from 1 to n .
statement: Given an integer n and an integer array rounds , consider a circular track divided into n sectors labeled from 1 to n . A marathon consisting of m rounds is conducted on this track. The i -th round starts at sector rounds[i-1] and ends at sector rounds[i] . For example, the first round starts at sector rounds[0] and ends at sector rounds[1] . Return an array listing the most visited sectors in ascending order. Note that the track is navigated in the counter-clockwise direction by sector numbers.
constraints: Move from each listed sector to the next by increasing labels and wrap n to one.
Return every most-visited sector in increasing numeric order.
hints: Every complete lap visits all sectors equally and cannot affect which sectors tie for maximum.
Only the path from the first listed sector to the final listed sector receives one extra visit.
List that inclusive interval, splitting at the wrap when start>end.
Concatenating low labels before high labels returns the result in ascending order.
editorial: Concatenating low labels before high labels returns the result in ascending order.

tests.explanation: After complete laps cancel equally, sectors one and two lie on the final partial traversal and are visited most.
Sector two is visited once more than sector one.
